faq_heading: West Central houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in West Central. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

West Central, Maple Ridge: 66 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 3%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 2 of 12 Maple Ridge communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in West Central fell from 68 in June to 66 in September (−2.9%), and 16 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 16.1% of Maple Ridge’s 410 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in West Central?
West Central also had 78 condos and townhomes listed and 10 sold in September, against 66 houses listed. The West Central condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: West Central home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

58 houses sold in West Central with a median price of $1,045,000 (the middle half sold between $936,250 and $1,193,750), taking a median of 20 days to sell at 96.3% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $483 per square foot, a median year built of 1972 and a median lot of 8,360 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in West Central?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 66 houses listed in West Central. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is West Central a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in West Central had a sales ratio of 3%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in West Central from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 16 houses sold in West Central over those 4 months, out of 188 in all of Maple Ridge.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in West Central?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in West Central sell for?
faq.a: 58 houses sold in West Central between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,045,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in West Central?
faq.a: The median was 20 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.3% of the last list price (5% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
